title: Homework set: arithmetic sequences and series
subject: Mathematics

source: Written for mathematics/y11 lesson 62 (Complete the portal's sequences set (6 questions) and update your repair list.)
intro: 6 questions. Show your working. Mark it with the mark scheme and add any errors to your repair list.

questions.q: Find an expression for the nth term of 4, 11, 18, 25, ...
Is 150 a term of the sequence 4, 11, 18, 25, ...? Give a reason.
questions.a: 7n − 3 = 150 gives n = 153/7 = 21.9 (M1); not a whole number, so no (A1)

questions.q: An arithmetic series has first term 3 and common difference 4. Find the sum of its first 20 terms.
Find the sum of the first 20 terms of 50 + 47 + 44 + ...
The 5th term of an arithmetic sequence is 23 and the 12th term is 58. Find the first term and the common difference.
How many terms of 2 + 5 + 8 + ... are needed for the sum to be greater than 500?
questions.a: Sₙ = n(3n + 1)/2 (M1); n = 18 gives 495 (M1); n = 19 gives 551 (A1); 19 terms (A1)
